about.title: A little bit about me
about.text: I started making stuff for real when I got my first 3D printer (the OG Ender3) and since then it has turned into a hobby and my passion. I love designing things and bringing them into the real world! But sometimes I need a break from PC and then I like to hike :)

about.title: What can I do
about.text: I'm most comfortable with programming (Python, C++) and 3D design (Fusion, FreeCAD). Lately I have also started learning PCB design to elevate my electronic projects. Besides that I am a robotics technician and I'm studying microelectronics.

contact.intro: If you have any questions don't hesitate to contact me! I would love to help you
